featuredCode.code:
def binary_search(arr: list[int], target: int) -> int:
    low, high = 0, len(arr) - 1
    while low <= high:
        mid = (low + high) // 2
        if arr[mid] == target: return mid
        if arr[mid] < target: low = mid + 1
        else: high = mid - 1
    return -1
